notable.author: @proj_chamber
notable.text:
Chamber v2 update:

We are skipping ahead to much larger models.

Creator fees now cover dedicated rented GPUs, so we are setting up the model families the original paper used (Qwen, Llama, Gemma and Phi, from 2B to 72B).

The paper's experiments will run across all of them so results can be compared by family.

Code and infrastructure are nearly done. Live within a few hours.

notable.author: @proj_chamber
notable.text:
Next for the Chamber: v2.

The current version is a simplified setup borrowed from an older repo. Fine for watching models under steering, not rigorous enough to conclude much.

v2 rebuilds it on the original paper's method, with its published data and code.

What changes:

• Steering vectors rebuilt from the paper's sentence set
• Steering strength calibrated so outputs stay coherent
• The paper's two-button choice task
• Matched controls for every condition
• Real and fake relief trials
• Hundreds of trials per condition, with hypotheses fixed before collection

The interesting part is replication across model families. We already run Llama and Phi live, so that is where v2 starts.

Current data moves to the archive.

notable.author: @proj_chamber
notable.text:
The full Research Chamber v2 code, configs and findings will be published openly.

The website stays up, and anyone can inspect, reproduce or build on the code, data and results.
